entry_points.summary: Propagates approved changes through plan artifacts; Phase 9 elevation proposer via propose-prefs.py after finalize.
Runs read-only multi-dimension audits with Phase 0 scope probe (LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY) and emits task artifacts. Accepts --scope-from <chunk-spec> for HEAVY sub-flow fan-out.
Audits existing SPEC/PLAN/TASKS; Phase 5 resolver pre-check (workflow.audit_to_amend); Phase 9 elevation proposer.

Audits plan artifacts for code-quality issues before implementation; requires STYLE.md (hard gate); Phase 5 resolver pre-check (workflow.audit_to_amend); Phase 9 elevation proposer; emits PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md.

Seeds planning with parallel ideation and anti-bias checks. Phase 0 scope probe (LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY) with per_vendor/per_framing axis taxonomy. HEAVY Phase 4 presents a (chunk x framing) selection matrix.
Runs heavy hypothesis-tournament debugging with post-mortem and Phase 10 memory review (shipped branch only).

Executes tiny plan-free changes with review gates. Calls config.py export-env during Setup; guards notifications via should-notify wrappers. Doc-fetcher dispatch gated on Z_HARNESS_DOCS_ALWAYS_APPLY (skipped when=never, Phase 2).
Exports commands/agents/skills to Cursor, Codex, or agy via adapter scripts; defaults to all targets.
Ships diagnosed bug fixes with consult and Codex review; slug-confirm resolver gate (workflow.slug_confirm) after hard collision check.
Orchestrates task queues with fresh subagents, reviewers, and auto memory review (Phase 9).
Implements one pending task with model selection and review.
Retrospects one run and proposes harness improvements.
Bootstraps two-tier human and LLM documentation.
Refreshes stale docs and previews proposed updates.
Reviews branch diffs into ranked task-shaped findings; requires STYLE.md.
Plans and ships small focused changes via FIX.md.
Splits large work into one-level cluster plans.
Produces SPEC.md, PLAN.md, and TASKS.md. Calls config.py export-env during Setup. Slug-confirm resolver gate (workflow.slug_confirm) after unconditional hard collision check.
Probes PATH for LLM CLIs and writes providers.json with interactively-confirmed role bindings.
Maps terrain with citations and cross-LLM critique. No recommendations — terrain only. Produces MAP.md. See /z-research for synthesis across map + brainstorm.

Higher-order meta-orchestrator: composes /z-map and /z-brainstorm, then runs adversarial synthesis panel (3 perspectives + research-judge) producing RESEARCH.md with 10-section schema including approach decision matrix. Cost 3-6M tokens; AskUser cost gate at invocation.
Final-gate reviews cumulative implementation, then auto-runs memory review (Phase 7).
Diagnoses and patches misleading skill or command files.
Reports run progress, timing, cost, next step, and memory-review activity (Phase 4b).
Authors STYLE.md from idiomatic captures + cross-LLM critique; --amend mines dismissal clusters.

Delegates memory authoring; accepts --from-candidate-json for automated candidate ingestion; accepts --kind routing-preference (with --question-id, --value, --strength, --scope, --reason) for structured workflow preference writes to docs/llm/workflow.json or docs/llm/workflow-<project-slug>.json.
Drafts semantic TESTS.md cases and links them to tasks.
Updates the z-harness plugin to the latest version.
Tiered bulk codebase quality uplift: decompose repo, cross-cut pass, per-component audits, sequential implement. Slug-confirm resolver gate (workflow.slug_confirm) after hard collision check.

invariants: Commands are Markdown procedure specs; planning, research, audit, and test commands do not write production code unless explicitly scoped to do so.
Route checks collect deterministic signals first; planning-router is advisory only when deterministic signals conflict.
Every route decision writes route-decision.md, emits plan_route_decision, asks the user, and never auto-executes the target command.
Primary routes are z-do, z-plan-light, z-plan, z-plan-split, z-brainstorm, and z-research; contextual exits include z-audit-plan, z-fix, z-debug, z-amend, and z-maintain-docs.
z-audit-plan is valid only with existing plan artifacts and remains read-only.
Review-family commands preserve evidence separately and promote only actionable findings into task-shaped artifacts consumed by z-implement-all --tasks.
z-implement-all preserves fresh-context implementation by delegating tasks to implementer and reviewer subagents.
Long consult-heavy phases use explicit compaction breakpoints or resumable state files where specified.

z-implement-all Phase 9 and z-review-all Phase 7 are soft auto-memory-review phases: all failure paths (malformed output, skipped helper, empty candidates) exit silently without halting the parent command.
z-debug Phase 10 is also a soft auto-memory-review phase and follows the same contract; the abandoned branch does not invoke run-memory-review.sh.

Every memory-review invocation (Phase 9, Phase 7, Phase 10) must emit exactly one memory_review_terminal event: the helper emits it on all skip paths; the orchestrator emits it after the user-gate loop for ran_empty and needs_user paths.
z-debug Phase 10 uses a 5-line stdout contract with run-memory-review.sh: line 1=status, line 2=cumulative_diff_path, line 3=spec_path (may be empty), line 4=tags_path, line 5=debug_md_path.

Memory candidates surfaced by Phase 9/Phase 7/Phase 10 are presented sequentially per candidate; accepted candidates are dispatched to z-suggest-memory --from-candidate-json with source prefix incident:<RUN>.
z-uplift never writes production code directly; it orchestrates audits via auditor subagents and delegates implementation to z-implement-all.
z-uplift gates on STYLE.md presence and doc-staleness before decomposition; it never auto-invokes z-style-init or z-maintain-docs.
z-uplift MANIFEST.md is the single source of truth for component state across phases and resumes; all state transitions are atomic via tmp-then-rename writes.
The cross-cutting synthetic component is excluded from Phase 3 per-component audit iteration and is handled in Phase 5 only.
perf is excluded from z-uplift default dimensions to bound cost; must be added explicitly via --dimensions.
z-style-init Mode A refuses if STYLE.md already exists; Mode B refuses if STYLE.md does not exist.
z-style-init grounds rules in observed source files and interview answers; it never invents rules that contradict observed code.
z-export delegates all file I/O to adapter scripts; the command itself performs no writes.
z-providers-discover enforces consultant_primary != consultant_secondary before writing providers.json.
z-providers-discover writes atomically via tmpfile+rename; it never leaves a partial providers.json.
z-audit-plan-style requires STYLE.md at repo root; there is no --no-style escape. Absence causes immediate refusal and routing to z-style-init.
z-audit-plan-style is read-only; plan mutations happen only via /z-amend applied to surviving PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md findings.
z-audit Phase 0 (scope-probe) is skipped when --scope-from is present; SKIP_PHASE_0=true is set before slug derivation, doc-fetcher, or run_start logging.

z-audit --scope-from always uses absolute-path-with-fragment form when dispatched by HEAVY fan-out; bare chunk IDs are for manual invocation only and require PARENT_RUN_ID + PARENT_SLUG in caller context.
z-brainstorm Phase 0 uses axis taxonomy [per_vendor, per_framing]; low-confidence probe results downgrade to MEDIUM without AskUser in v1a.
z-brainstorm sub-flows (HEAVY fan-out) skip Phase 0 entirely — anti-sprawl invariant prevents recursive fan-out.
z-brainstorm HEAVY Phase 4 presents a (chunk x framing) selection matrix; N_PAIRS <= 12 uses a single AskUserQuestion, N_PAIRS > 12 uses two-step chunk-then-framing selection.
z-brainstorm HEAVY abandons set chosen_framing: abandoned (not chosen_pair) to keep abandon detection uniform across LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY modes.
All commands that fire notifications call scripts/config.py should-notify --event <type> and act only when the return is yes; no command checks Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY_LEVEL directly.
Commands that send notifications or apply docs call scripts/config.py export-env during Setup before any phase runs; z-do and z-plan are the canonical examples.
Resolver hooks (resolve-question) branch on {result: skip|prefill|ask}; a resolver error (any non-zero exit) always falls back to asking the user normally — never silently skips.

The hard slug-collision check (PLAN.md/TASKS.md already in slug dir) runs unconditionally in z-plan, z-fix, and z-uplift before resolve-question is called; the resolver only governs the soft non-obvious-slug gate that follows.

z-audit-plan Phase 9, z-audit-plan-style Phase 9, and z-amend Phase 9 are soft elevation-proposer phases: if propose-prefs.py returns empty or a non-zero exit, the phase is skipped silently with no AskUserQuestion surfaced.

z-suggest-memory --kind routing-preference writes to docs/llm/workflow.json (global) or docs/llm/workflow-<project-slug>.json (project); the file is created with INDEX.json registration if absent; MEMORIES-FLAT.md is regenerated after every write.
Suppression entries in .z-harness/.propose-suppress are keyed by question_id with a Unix-epoch expiry (30 days); an unexpired entry causes the elevation proposer to skip entirely.
gotchas: Do not add z-audit-plan as a front-door planning route when no plan exists; route to z-plan instead.
Route chains prevent ping-pong; after two entries or immediate return-to-prior, ask the user to choose.
z-implement-all --tasks derives BASE from the provided tasks file and bypasses normal slug/tree discovery.
Promoted REVIEW-TASKS.md and MR-REVIEW.md artifacts should be pruned by the user before z-implement-all --tasks consumes them.
z-suggest-memory is a thin delegator; memory mutation lives in skills/z-suggest-memory/SKILL.md.
Plain z-maintain-docs is dry-run by default; docs writes require --apply or explicit confirmation.
--from-candidate-json on z-suggest-memory accepts a file path or - (stdin); it is the automated path used by Phase 9/Phase 7/Phase 10 only — interactive callers should omit it.

z-stats Phase 4b reads review_agent_call events from metrics.jsonl; these are emitted by z-implement-all Phase 9, z-review-all Phase 7, and z-debug Phase 10. The section is empty if none of these phases have run yet for the selected slug.
Phase 9 in z-implement-all and Phase 10 in z-debug each cap the sequential AskUserQuestion loop at 3 candidates per run; Phase 7 in z-review-all has no hard cap but stops early on Skip-all-remaining.
z-debug Phase 10 memory review is skipped entirely on the abandoned branch; no memory_review_terminal event is emitted for inconclusive debug sessions.
z-debug Phase 10 clears .notify-dedup-session at the start of each fresh invocation; without this, notify dedup state from a prior session bleeds into the current one.
z-debug Phase 10 D11 push-notify policy: push-notify at most once per (slug, skip_reason) pair for skipped_broken_context states, deduplicated via .notify-dedup-session.

z-debug Phase 2.5 bisect fast-path: all three gates must hold (known-good ref, reproducibility confirmed yes, scriptable repro). Non-ok bisect returns fall through to Phase 3a silently — bisect never blocks the pipeline, never replaces hypothesis generation, and never pre-fills the winning hypothesis.
z-uplift slug collision detection presents one AskUserQuestion per colliding slug before COMPONENTS.md is written; collision resolution choices must be applied before MANIFEST.md initialization.
z-uplift --refresh-component archives both REPORT.md and TASKS.md atomically (stage-then-rename) before resetting the MANIFEST row; both files must exist or the command exits with an error.
z-uplift resume detection reads MANIFEST state before entering any phase; SKIP_TO_PHASE guards must be checked at the top of every skippable phase — not only inside the phase body.
z-uplift cross-cutting context (C-NNN lines) is filtered per component slug using exact-match on the component: field; global or mismatched slugs are silently excluded from the per-component prompt.
z-style-init --amend Mode B exits early (no change) when DISMISSED_SIGNATURES is empty or N_CLUSTERS is 0 after Jaccard clustering with min-2-member filter.
z-style-init --amend add-with-edits interactive free-text flow is deferred to v2; users must reject and manually edit STYLE.md to customize a proposed rule.
z-style-init Phase 4 parallel critique: if both consultants fail, critique is skipped with a log event and the draft proceeds to user review unmodified.
z-style-init --ingest skips the interview and Capture phases entirely; SOURCE is set to 'ingest' in the frontmatter.
z-providers-discover last-assignment-wins for multi-CLI role selections; consultant_primary/consultant_secondary collision triggers a reprompt loop until resolved or one role is unbound.
z-export --target=all runs cursor, codex, agy sequentially — not in parallel. A failed target does not abort subsequent targets.
z-export exits nonzero immediately for unrecognized --target values before running any scripts.

z-audit-plan-style PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md is separate from z-audit-plan's PLAN_AUDIT_REPORT.md; correctness concerns from the plan-style-reviewer are noted in a Cross-dimension note but not promoted into amendment blocks.
z-audit-plan-style archives any existing PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md before overwriting; this archive is what extract-dismissals.py reads to compute prior dismissal signatures on subsequent runs.
z-audit --scope-from must be parsed BEFORE Setup (before slug derivation, doc-fetcher, or run_start logging); SCOPE_FROM_ERROR is stored for deferred halt after RUN is established.

z-audit HEAVY fan-out chunk-artifact path validation: dest must be under chunks_dir; source absolute paths must start with Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR or one of the per-chunk findings_path directories from the sub-flow archive — not arbitrary paths.
z-audit HEAVY reconciliation skips Phase 2 (auditor dispatch) and Phase 3 (merge findings) entirely; those phases produce per-dimension findings files that do not exist in the HEAVY path.
z-brainstorm HEAVY Phase 4 Back-loop is capped at 3 iterations; the fourth Back is treated as Abandon.
z-brainstorm SCOPE-brainstorm.json is the live file read by Phase 4 to determine HEAVY mode; the archive copy is at archive/<RUN>/SCOPE.json. These are different files — do not confuse them.
z-brainstorm scope-probe low-confidence results are silently downgraded to MEDIUM in v1a — no AskUser gate.
Notification policy is now driven by config.py should-notify; do not check Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY_LEVEL directly in command procedures. The canonical reference for knobs is docs/human/config.md.
Resolver pre-check for workflow.audit_to_amend is used in BOTH z-audit-plan (Phase 5) and z-audit-plan-style (Phase 5); the same question_id is shared between the two commands.
The hard slug-collision check runs unconditionally before resolve-question in z-plan, z-fix, and z-uplift; a resolver result of 'skip' does NOT bypass the collision check.
z-suggest-memory --kind routing-preference does not prompt interactively; it writes the memory entry directly. All required flags must be passed at invocation — unlike the default interactive path.
